Dear OSCR team,

My name is Victor and a beginner in oSCR. Well, yesterday I was running the R code of the paper "Spatial capture–recapture analysis of arti cial cover board survey data reveals small scale spatial variation in slow-worm Anguis fragilis density". 

However, I could not complete the process, because the object "doy" was not found (see below, , marked in red color). 

Also, I checked if the object "doy" was created, but it does not appear as a declared variable. 

> exists("doy")
[1] FALSE

What could be going on? 

Best, Victor

Hi Victor,

 

doy is a trap level covariate. You can access it as follows:

 

session <- 1

occasion  <- 1

 

scrFrame$trapCovs[[session]][[occasion]]

 

Let me know if that is what you were looking for.

 

Chris

To: oSCR <oscr_p...@googlegroups.com>
